title: LuPNet: Lung Perfusion Network model of the fibrotic lung and its pulmonary circulation
description: Physics-based network model of the fibrotic lung and its pulmonary circulation, with a shared shear-stress remodelling law for the pulmonary vessels, in silico cohorts of pulmonary hypertension in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, and a browser-based research calculator. Code, data and simulations accompanying the manuscript 'A vascular contribution to pulmonary hypertension in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis'.
